GOOD TO KNOW

Before you settle in.

A few answers to make planning your visit easier.

Have another
question?

Talk with the inn about your plans.

Contact the team →
How do I check rates and availability?+
Use our ResNexus booking page for current rooms, prices, and reservation terms. A reservation is confirmed by the booking provider, not by this website.
Can we reserve rooms for a wedding or group?+
Yes—contact the inn to discuss a room block or a full-property gathering. Room availability, event arrangements, and the terms of your quote must be confirmed with the team.
What if I will arrive after front-desk hours?+
Contact the front desk before your stay to arrange an after-hours arrival. Ask the team to confirm your arrival instructions and check-in and check-out times.
How do I request a particular room or accessibility feature?+
Call 920-644-2087 before booking. Describe the room layout, bathroom, elevator access, or other features you need so the team can confirm a suitable room.
Can I bring a pet?+
Please contact the inn before booking to confirm the current pet policy, eligible rooms, and any applicable fees.
When is the Beaumont Bar open?+
The bar’s published schedule lists Friday and Saturday evenings from 5 p.m. Contact the inn for the current closing time and any private-event closures.
Where should I park?+
Contact the front desk for current parking and unloading directions before you arrive.
What should I know before visiting Horicon Marsh?+
Check the refuge visitor guide for routes, seasonal access, and facility information. The refuge and state wildlife area have different access rules.
